description: This file defines the navigation logic for a mobile application, including an enumeration of different screens, a class to manage current navigation state, and a composable function to remember the navigation state.

classes.name: MainNavScreen
classes.description: Enumeration of different screens in the app (Home, Browse, Favorites, etc.)

classes.name: MainNav
classes.description: Class to manage current navigation state and optionally hold a recipe ID for detail view

methods.name: go
methods.description: Method to change the current screen and optionally update the detail recipe ID

methods.name: rememberMainNav
methods.description: Composable function to initialize and remember the MainNav state in the Compose runtime
